t: How the Dataset Join Recommender works (Signature)
title: How the Dataset Join Recommender works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Dataset Join Recommender does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature approach scores joinability with frozen weights — key overlap, uniqueness, type compatibility — so the same dataset pair always gets the same recommendation. Each recommendation carries its score ledger with per-signal contributions, and sample-join verification results are attached before any full join is advised. Cardinality warnings are computed, not guessed. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
